workflow.name: Surveying
workflow.description: We measure on site, or from drawings when that is what the programme needs. Skirting, joinery, doors and windows come out of the area. What is left is the wall that will actually be hung.
paragraphs: We measure on site, or from drawings when that is what the programme needs. Skirting, joinery, doors and windows come out of the area. What is left is the wall that will actually be hung.

Quantities include wastage and pattern repeat. The allowance is typically 15–30%, depending on the pattern repeat and the layout, with staircases at the high end (around 30%) because of the angles. A roll that looks generous on a plan can run short on the last pier.
The survey is also a judgement on the wall. If it is not ready for the material specified, we say so before anyone orders the last drop.

workflow.name: Project management
workflow.description: Every project has a project leader on the ground. That person is the day-to-day contact for the craft, the progress and the expectations that have been set.
paragraphs: Every project has a project leader on the ground. That person is the day-to-day contact for the craft, the progress and the expectations that have been set.

On a longer commission, senior oversight checks the quality of the work and agrees a forward plan with you, in person, each week. Frequent and plain communication is part of the method, not a courtesy added at the end.

The team you meet on the first day is the core team that finishes. Disruption is kept low: work is contained, floors and joinery are protected, and the place is left tidy every evening. In a home we are visitors. In a hotel we work around the house.

workflow.name: Supply
workflow.description: On many hotel and flagship jobs the designer, the brand or the client supplies the wallcovering (free-issue). We manage delivery, check it against the measure, and hang what was specified.
paragraphs: On many hotel and flagship jobs the designer, the brand or the client supplies the wallcovering (free-issue). We manage delivery, check it against the measure, and hang what was specified.
We can also procure. Either way, the order has to cover the repeat and the wastage, or the last wall is the one that waits.
Rolls are inspected as part of preparation; on large volumes not every roll can be opened in advance. Any defect is reported straight away to the designer, contractor and manufacturer.
Delivery is timed to the hang. Paper sitting in a corridor for days is a risk to the goods and a nuisance to the building.

workflow.name: Installation
workflow.description: This is the craft Mr Wallcover is built on. Wallcovering installation for hotels, retail flagships and prime residential rooms, including paper on joinery where the drawings show it.
paragraphs: This is the craft Mr Wallcover is built on. Wallcovering installation for hotels, retail flagships and prime residential rooms, including paper on joinery where the drawings show it.

Preparation, where it is in the specification, includes stripping old paper, dustless sanding, and making good cracks and uneven surfaces. Some materials are specified with a lining paper. Some, including certain mural installs, are specified without one. We follow the specification.
We set out every wall with a laser level. Deliveries are checked against the measure, and batches and shading are managed so that a room reads as one surface.

Protection of floors, furniture and finished joinery is part of the hang, not an optional extra. Where Mr Wallcover is appointed as main decorating contractor, the package can include fine painting, French polishing and other specialist finishes, as it did at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair.

workflow.name: Aftercare
workflow.description: Aftercare is the fifth part of the service. A return visit is included once the paper has settled, about four to six weeks after completion. Seams and edges are attended to. There is a priority repair call-out for the workmanship, and a twelve-month guarantee.
paragraphs: Aftercare is the fifth part of the service. A return visit is included once the paper has settled, about four to six weeks after completion. Seams and edges are attended to. There is a priority repair call-out for the workmanship, and a twelve-month guarantee.
The detail, including care by material and what the guarantee does not cover, is on the aftercare page.
